derivation.accuracy: No source. Level-1 baseline by class: Priest and Ranger 80 (both are built to hit reliably), Rogue 78, Warrior and Mage 75, Paladin 72 (heavy and slow), Civilian 70 (untrained). Level rows add roughly +5 a level, so a level-10 hero lands near the 100 mark where surplus starts converting to Crit at ÷4.
derivation.crit: Base 3 — documented in the stat sheet. Rogue starts at 5, the only class whose identity is landing one.
derivation.luck: No source, and a rare grant in the level tables. Everyone starts at 0.
derivation.vision: Base radius 6 — documented. Ranger 8 and Rogue 7 and Mage 7, the three classes that trade on seeing first.
derivation.staminaMax: 5 at level 1 — documented. Civilian 0: a Civilian has no stamina bar.
derivation.staminaRegen: 1 at level 1 — documented, and it hard-caps at 3. Civilian 0.
derivation.surge: Not a baseline at all — Surge always EQUALS the character level. Documented rule, computed, never stored.
derivation.toughness: Ported, not derived: hell-tcg maxAfflictions IS injury capacity, which is what Toughness means here.
